remarks: Charming One-Bedroom Apartment - All Utilities Included! Cute as a button! This cozy second-floor one-bedroom apartment is nestled in a delightful antique colonial home and comes with full third-floor attic for storage. The bright kitchen features a freestanding oven/range, refrigerator, and microwave, with space left for a dining table. A convenient in-unit washer/dryer is neatly tucked into a laundry closet. All utilities are included-electricity, heat, hot water, and central air conditioning-making for hassle-free living. Assigned off-street parking is located behind the building. Located in a prime area close to the train station, shopping, and restaurants, this gem combines comfort, convenience, and character in one perfect package.
